case.question: What is the concept called that suggests crime can be reduced by altering the physical features of an environment?

Choices:
A. Defensible space
B. Zone of transition
C. Sanitized zone
D. Defended area
E. Environmental design
F. Environmental modification
G. Defended space
H. None of the other choices
I. Environmental deterrence
J. Environmental defense

Solve the question. At the end, write exactly one final line in this format and do not write anything after it:
Answer: <letter>

response.content:
The concept refers to Oscar Newman’s idea that the built/physical environment can be designed or modified—through territoriality, natural surveillance, image, and milieu—to discourage criminal behavior. Among the options, this is best known as “defensible space.”

Answer: A
